AUTHOR: Jansen
TITLE: Monitoring tropical freshwater fish with underwater videography and deep learning
REGION: Kakadu National Park / Ranger Uranium Mine, Alligator Rivers Region, Northern Territory, Australia (Mudginberri, Sandy, Gulungul, Georgetown billabongs)
SPECIES: 23 tropical freshwater taxa (e.g., Ambassis macleayi, A. agrammus, Amniataba percoides, Craterocephalus stercusmuscarum, Melanotaenia splendida inornata, Neosilurus spp., Lates calcarifer)
DATA: Own unbaited GoPro videos: training 392 deployments 2016-2019 (channel billabongs) + 180 deployments 2019 (backflow); 44,112 annotated images, 82,904 boxes; independent test 286 one-hour videos May 2020-2022
V_EV: Training dataset: 'Deteriorating light and turbidity also make identification difficult. Annotations were only made in clear conditions satisfying these criteria.'
D2: Training images 2016-2019 (Azure internal 80:20 random train/test); independent MaxN test set = 286 videos from 2020-2022
D_EV: Test dataset: 'An independent test dataset was derived from two-hundred eighty-six 1-h video files collected from channel billabong fish monitoring (Mudginberri and Sandy) in May 2020, 2021 and 2022'
R_EV: Discussion: 'This difference in accuracy between the model's training metrics (e.g. 83.6% mAP) and its performance in real-world situations (e.g. 54.4% MaxN-F1)' (test years 2020-2022 vs training 2016-2019)
C_EV: Fig. 4: 'Taxa-specific measures of MaxN-F1, MaxN-precision and MaxN-recall (%) at increasing confidence thresholds for accepting the model's output probability.'
E_EV: Abstract/Methods: 'Fish abundance (MaxN) was measured by trained observers and deep learning ... PERMANOVA was used to compare method, year and billabong.'
ARCH: Microsoft Azure Custom Vision 'general' object detection model (architecture not disclosed); taxon-specific confidence thresholds; MaxN per video
METR: mAP, precision, recall (Azure 20% split); MaxN-precision, MaxN-recall, MaxN-F1 per taxon; PERMANOVA, PCO, SIMPER on Bray-Curtis
NOTE: V: annotation restricted to clear conditions without measuring turbidity -> P1 -> V_ALL=N; sampling timed for 'high clarity of surface waters' (qualitative). D: two designs - Azure internal 80:20 random image split for mAP, and a temporally independent test set (2020-2022 vs 2016-2019 training) for MaxN; coded on the latter (D1=조사일; a verifier could choose a year-based label). R: test years differ from training years (same billabongs, same program); P2 allows season/year -> R1=Y; in-domain mAP 83.6% vs MaxN-F1 54.4% are different metrics but explicitly contrasted numerically -> R3=Y (borderline). C: 80% probability/30% IoU defaults plus per-taxon thresholds chosen by sweeping 20-99.9% (Fig. 4) -> C_ALL=P; 'visual interrogation of model predictions' only suggested. E: MaxN vs trained-observer MaxN of the same videos; assemblage-level PERMANOVA across 3 years (could be argued E1=복수 with 개체군 추세). Per-taxon MaxN-recall reported but not framed as FNR -> E4=없음. Text includes a corrigendum page before the article.
